label: 74HC74 Dual D Flip-Flop with /PRE and /CLR

semantics.notes: Dual D-FF, each with independent clock (clk1/clk2). /PRE and /CLR are active-low asynchronous overrides. /PRE=0 forces Q=1. /CLR=0 forces Q=0. /PRE=/CLR=0 is forbidden (both Q and Q̄ go HIGH). clockInputId is NOT set because there are two independent clocks — race/setup-hold detection does not operate for this gate. Each FF uses separate clock. stateKeys=['q1','q2'] are the exposed state for STT.

exportSupport.verilogNotes: Each FF: always @(posedge clk1 or negedge pre1 or negedge clr1) — with async /PRE and /CLR. q driven as reg, qn driven by assign.
exportSupport.vhdlNotes: process(clk1, pre1, clr1) with rising_edge + async conditions.

testability.notes: Test both FFs independently: normal clocked operation; async /PRE override; async /CLR override; /PRE-before-clock; /CLR-during-clock; forbidden /PRE=/CLR=0 combination (Q=Q̄=1). Verify defaultInputValues=1 for /PRE and /CLR keep them inactive when unconnected.

risks.description: /PRE=/CLR=0 forbidden: both Q and Q̄ go HIGH (Q=1, Q̄=1). Model maps this explicitly. Real hardware race when both released simultaneously.
clockInputId=null — no setup/hold race detection for either clock. Users may not notice timing violations.

modelLimits: Race condition on simultaneous /PRE and /CLR release not simulated.
Propagation delay=14ns applies to both FFs equally (not independent).
No cross-coupling between FF1 and FF2 in this model.
